description: Recorded HTTP responses used by the offline (replay) mode of mcp_server_ly.py and by the offline tests. Payloads were captured from the live AlphaFold DB API (v6 models) and the UniProt REST API on 2026-10-26; large responses were trimmed, and a few records were rebuilt in the exact API format from the captured values (AF-P68872-F1 summary fields other than id/score, and the HBB/TP53 confidenceCategory arrays, which are derived from the captured scores with AFDB's H>=90/M>=70/L>=50 rule). Trimmed: sequence-summary hit lists, UniProt lineages; the UniProt file merges the records of the HBB and TP53 accession queries, AlphaMissense tables reduced to the residues used in the examples. Routes are matched on host + path (+ query subset); the most specific match wins. Any URL without a route raises a connection error (reported by the server as UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE), so replay mode never invents data it did not record.
